newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Madge Networks raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Madge Networks raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it raised its rating of Madge Networks Inc to outperform from neutral.
-- cited Madge Networks' fourth quarter earnings, which surpassed analysts' consensus estimates.
-- Lehman said it was encouraged that gross margins improved to 48 percent from 46.5 percent in the third quarter.
-- raised the fiscal 1997 revenues estimate to $560 milion from $527 million and earnings to $0.30 a share from $0.20 a share.
-- set a 1998 estimate of $675 million in revenues and $0.65 a share in earnings.
